description: This file defines an Android Activity class named Grid2 that displays a grid of images using a custom adapter ImageAdapter. The adapter loads drawable resources into ImageView elements within a GridView.

classes.name: Grid2
classes.description: An Activity that displays a grid of images with a custom adapter.

classes.name: ImageAdapter
classes.description: A custom adapter extending BaseAdapter to provide ImageView items for the GridView.

methods.name: Grid2.onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets the layout, and associates the ImageAdapter with the GridView.

methods.name: ImageAdapter.<init>
methods.description: Constructor that stores the context for subsequent use.

methods.name: ImageAdapter.getCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of images.

methods.name: ImageAdapter.getItem
methods.description: Returns the position of the item; simple stub in this case.

methods.name: ImageAdapter.getItemId
methods.description: Returns the position as the item ID.

methods.name: ImageAdapter.getView
methods.description: Creates or reuses an ImageView, sets its parameters and image resource based on position, and returns it.
